case_variable: ego longitudinal movement direction relative to sourced highway designation and physically observed one-way signs
fixed_context: same authored road bytes, two same-direction driving lanes, sign requests, ego blueprint, weather, capture profile and stationary background

measurements.road_direction: Native map topology and lane direction readback at every occupied ego frame
measurements.physical_sign: camera-frame and map-actor identity, facing direction, text/code and visibility for sign 101 and sign 102
measurements.designation_authority: source-hashed authoritative highway designation record separate from an authored map tag
measurements.ego_motion: source-bound Native frame/time, transform, body vertices, heading, speed and signed longitudinal displacement
measurements.wrong_way: actual motion opposite to the sourced designated direction while the body occupies the designated highway

fallback_routing.fallback1: measured sign occlusion at entry routes to a slower approach for sign review
fallback_routing.fallback2: measured lane-center or camera-framing failure routes to the outer same-direction lane
fallback_routing.fallback3: measured conflicting or absent designation authority routes to stop-before-entry request

legal_limit: Authored OpenDRIVE R6-1 requests and synthetic rows do not establish actual sign visibility, government designation, a legal wrong-way verdict or accepted original evidence
